highlights.title: When Starshield Cut Out, Ukrainian Drones Fell From the Skies
highlights.summary: Ukraine says it still doesn’t know why the military satellite internet service, a sister to Starlink, was abruptly throttled, leaving troops vulnerable to Russian attacks.

highlights.title: Análise: quem está por trás dos protestos violentos na França e quem pode se beneficiar deles?
highlights.summary: País está dividido sobre o que levou a alguns dos piores distúrbios vistos em cidades francesas na história moderna; mas quem ganha com o caos no país?

highlights.title: Drone Strike Kills More Than 150 in Abyei in Sudan’s Civil War
highlights.summary: Struggling against each other on the battlefield, the sides in Sudan’s civil war are relying on drones to strike across vast distances, inflicting huge tolls on civilians in the process.

highlights.title: Macron rejects Trump’s claims blaming migrants for French riots
highlights.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron condemned comments by "foreign leaders" on the violent protests in France on October 17. He has now arrived in Saudi Arabia as part of his Gulf tour.
